headlines.title: Germany raises competition concerns over PayPal surcharging ban
headlines.summary: According to Bundeskartellamt, PayPal is one of the most widely used online payment methods in Germany.

headlines.title: Can PYPL Stock Build On Its Recovery? This Analyst Raises Target To $60, Burry Is Also Adding Shares
headlines.summary: Bernstein analyst Harshita Rawat raised the price target on PayPal to $60 from $55 and maintained a ‘Market Perform’ rating on the shares.

headlines.title: Michael Burry Re-Enters LULU On Weakness, Boosts Positions In MercadoLibre, PayPal, JD And More
headlines.summary: Burry cited lululemon’s new management’s failure so far to reverse a prolonged “black hole” in marketing and messaging, which has left the stock overlooked during a low-information stretch.

headlines.title: David Einhorn’s Best Buy Is Already Up 36%. Is It Too Late to Follow Him?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysPayPal is up 36% since June 30, the best of the seven stocks David Einhorn’s Greenlight Capital bought or added to in the second quarter. Even after that run, PayPal trades at 10x forward earnings, well below its five-year average, so it isn’t too late to follow him.

headlines.title: PayPal (PYPL) Stock May Be 50% Undervalued As Barclays Cuts Rating
headlines.summary: PayPal Holdings has seen its share price fall 72.4% over the past 5 years, which puts an uncomfortable spotlight on a basic question for investors: whether the current price is supported by the returns the business earns on its capital. With the stock now around US$58.78 and sentiment reshaped by recent earnings and analyst reactions, the focus naturally shifts to what those underlying returns really look like. description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
